purpose: Preserve bounded component evidence and close low-yield public-search branches without admitting it as HRS full-loop validation.

classification.reason: The trace has useful time/pressure/temperature/flow/cumulative-transfer channels, but it is a reactor-material cycling experiment rather than a hydrogen-refuelling station or station-to-vehicle loop. The repository has no explicit license, so the raw rows are not copied into this project.

allowed_use: provenance-tracked component dynamics screening after a physics-compatibility review
offline parser and phase-marker robustness checks
data-request lead for a custodian-approved export
prohibited_claims: station controller, cascade, ESD or protocol validation
dispersion, fire, consequence distance or emergency-response effectiveness
